vintage: USDA ERS Feed Grains Database, Feed Grains Yearbook Tables -- All Years

definitions.stocks_to_use: ending stocks / total use, same marketing year; endogenous to that season's yield and therefore not used to condition it
definitions.carryin_stocks_to_use: the prior marketing year's stocks_to_use; predetermined at planting and the conditioner the transmission uses

note: The current marketing year is a WASDE projection, flagged is_projection and excluded from the trend fit and the transmission fit. It is the source of the runner's default reference price and carry-in ratio.
